lines: Gaye dinon ka suragh le kar, kidhar se aaya kidhar gaya woh
couplets.en: With a trace of days gone by, where did he come from and where did he go?

lines: Ajeeb manoos ajnabi tha, mujhe to hairan kar gaya woh
couplets.en: What a strangely familiar stranger he was, leaving me bewildered.

lines: Bas ek moti si chhab dikha kar, bas ek meethi si dhun suna kar
couplets.en: He gave us a glimpse of his pearly radiance and let us hear one sweet refrain.

lines: Sitara-e-shaam ban ke aaya, ba-rang-e-khwab-e-sahar gaya woh
couplets.en: He came like the evening star and vanished like a dream at dawn.

lines: Gaye dinon ka suragh le kar, kidhar se aaya kidhar gaya woh
couplets.en: With a trace of days gone by, where did he come from and where did he go?

lines: Shikasta-pa raah mein khara hoon, gaye dinon ko bula raha hoon
couplets.en: I stand wounded on the road, calling back the days that have gone.

lines: Shikasta-pa raah mein khara hoon, gaye dinon ko bula raha hoon
couplets.en: I stand wounded on the road, calling back the days that have gone.

lines: Jo qafila mera hamsafar tha, misaal-e-gard-e-safar gaya woh
couplets.en: The caravan that travelled with me drifted away like dust from the road.

lines: Woh hijr ki raat ka sitara, woh ham-nafas ham-sukhan hamara
couplets.en: He was the star of our night apart, the friend who shared our breath and words.

lines: Woh hijr ki raat ka sitara, woh ham-nafas ham-sukhan hamara
couplets.en: He was the star of our night apart, the friend who shared our breath and words.

lines: Sada rahe us ka naam pyara, suna hai kal raat mar gaya woh
couplets.en: May his name stay dear to us, for I hear he died last night.

lines: Woh raat ka be-nawa musafir, woh tera shair woh tera Nasir
couplets.en: There was that voiceless traveller of the night, your poet, your Nasir.

lines: Woh raat ka be-nawa musafir, woh tera shair woh tera Nasir

lines: Teri gali tak to ham ne dekha tha, phir na jaane kidhar gaya woh
couplets.en: We saw him as far as your lane, and who knows where he went from there?
